Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Demotion]]: Admiral Ozzel chokes to death on a viewscreen while Captain Piett looks on, in ''The Empire Strikes Back''. Darth Vader, talking to him by hologram, tells him "You have failed me for the last time, Admiral," and then makes Piett admiral in his place.

Source: [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/File:Ozzel_croaks.jpg Ozzel croaks.jpg], Wookieepedia (a frame from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' (1980); 1632 by 816 pixels). Reduced to 800 by 400 pixels and converted to JPEG.
